I reciprocate with a ‘love you too ma’ but the constant pandering was a little much for me. This issue arose again recently. Ma and her husband went on a mini break for five days. When she came back, she practically ran to me and hugged me, saying how much she had missed me. Here’s where I may be the arsehole. I then said ‘Mum, that’s weird. You were on holiday with your husband and should have been enjoying yourself not worrying about me!’ Apparently this was very much the wrong thing to say as she got all upset. Honestly I don’t think I was being an arsehole, just that my mum needs to cut the apron strings a little. But I await my judgement!
